en.title: Rich Messages Land, Ephemeral Replies Go Private, and Bot API 10.3 Spans the Stack
summary: Bot API 10.1–10.3 crosses the full GramIO stack: types, contexts, files, format, keyboards, core, testing, JSX, and scaffolding
Breaking: send methods accept receiver and callback fields only inside ephemeral_message_parameters
Rich Messages gain escaped helpers, documents, expandable credited quotes, button rows, compact tables, and a rich JSX runtime
Recursive file extraction uploads documents and media from deeply nested rich-message blocks
stopped_message_generation gets a typed context and is included in default allowed_updates
Communities, join-request queries, and subscription updates become first-class framework events
InlineKeyboard.disabled() and forceReply() land in builders and keyboard JSX
@gramio/callback-data 0.2 adds a zero-width codec for typed reply-keyboard payloads
@gramio/test can stop drafts and returns realistic ephemeral-message mock responses
Wrappergram 2.0 moves to a middleware core, direct results, TelegramError, suppress, and opt-in file handling
@gramio/views 0.2.1 restores 10.3 media compatibility without pretending a two-file live photo is one-file media
Response-like file downloads and topic-aware callback sends also shipped during the cycle
create-gramio 2.3 generates projects on gramio 0.14 and @gramio/test 0.8

ru.title: Rich Messages приехали, эфемерные ответы стали приватными, Bot API 10.3 раскатился по всему стеку
summary: Bot API 10.1–10.3 проходит через весь стек GramIO: types, contexts, files, format, keyboards, core, testing, JSX и генератор проектов
Breaking: send-методы принимают receiver и callback поля только внутри ephemeral_message_parameters
Rich Messages получили безопасные хелперы, документы, раскрываемые цитаты с credit, ряды кнопок, компактные таблицы и rich JSX runtime
Рекурсивный file extraction загружает документы и медиа из глубоко вложенных rich-блоков
stopped_message_generation получил типизированный контекст и вошёл в стандартные allowed_updates
Communities, join-request queries и апдейты подписок стали полноценными событиями фреймворка
InlineKeyboard.disabled() и forceReply() появились в builder API и keyboard JSX
@gramio/callback-data 0.2 добавляет zero-width codec для типизированных payload reply-клавиатур
@gramio/test умеет останавливать draft и возвращает реалистичные моки эфемерных сообщений
Wrappergram 2.0 перешёл на middleware-core, прямые результаты, TelegramError, suppress и opt-in обработку файлов
@gramio/views 0.2.1 восстанавливает совместимость media с 10.3, не маскируя двухфайловый live photo под однофайловое media
В том же цикле приехали Response-like загрузка файлов и topic-aware отправка из callback context
create-gramio 2.3 создаёт проекты на gramio 0.14 и @gramio/test 0.8

en.title: Bot API 10.0 Lands Ecosystem-Wide & Scenes Become Composers
summary: Bot API 10.0 across the stack: @gramio/types v10, contexts v0.7, files v0.5, format v0.8, gramio v0.10
Bot API 10.0: live photos (LivePhotoAttachment, sendLivePhoto), guest messages, poll & poll-option media
Bot API 10.0: deleteReaction/deleteAllReactions, canReactToMessages permission, bot access settings
gramio v0.10.0: bot.guestQuery() shorthand + ctx.answerGuestQuery() for the new guest_message update
gramio v0.10.0: chosenInlineResult now accepts a CallbackData schema — typed ctx.queryData from result_id
gramio v0.10.0: no-trigger bot.inlineQuery(handler) overload matches any inline query
gramio v0.10.0 fix: no lost updates when stopping mid-batch; typed bots assignable to webhookHandler
@gramio/scenes v0.7.0: scene-as-composer — Scene now extends EventComposer with the full bot-level DSL
@gramio/scenes v0.7.0: builder steps .step(name, c => c.enter().on()) with per-step lifecycle + auto-state inference
@gramio/scenes v0.7.0: reusable step modules via scene.extend(otherScene) and a new onExit lifecycle hook
@gramio/scenes v0.7.1: fix — onEnter-consumed scene derives run exactly once per update again (0.7.0 ran them twice on entry)
@gramio/onboarding v0.2.0: typed build() — ctx.onboarding propagates through bot.extend() with no augmentation

en.title: GramIO v0.5.0 — Composer Rearchitecture, Observability & Testing Superpowers
summary: gramio v0.5.0 drops middleware-io and builds entirely on @gramio/composer
@gramio/composer v0.2.0: decorate(), when(), inspect(), trace() added
Shorthand methods (hears, command, reaction, etc.) moved to Composer — plugins can use them too
Middleware now named for meaningful stack traces — no more anonymous wrappers
trace() enables zero-overhead OpenTelemetry / Datadog integration
when() provides build-time conditional middleware registration
@gramio/test reaches v0.1.0 with reactions, inline queries, and chosen inline results
New fluent scope API: user.in(chat).on(msg).react() chains read like user stories
Automatic reaction state tracking — old_reaction auto-computed from memory
@gramio/scenes adds onInvalidInput option to ask() for custom validation error messages
Storage interface v2.0.1 uses generic typed keys across all adapters
MaybeArray now accepts readonly arrays

trace() — нулевой оверхед для интеграции OpenTelemetry / Datadog

Fluent-скоупы: user.in(chat).on(msg).react() — цепочки как пользовательские сценарии
